---
name: Bug or documentation discrepancy
about: Report a reproducible public-data behavior or documentation issue without secrets
---

## Expected behavior

What did the documented feature or command claim to do?

## Observed behavior

Provide a sanitized example only; remove tokens, IDs, private positions, request bodies, account details and logs containing private data.

## Reproduction and context

Source revision, platform, bounded commands (do not run Production commands), relevant public evidence link and as-of date.

## Safety scope

Did this concern only source/offline tests, or is a deployed behavior alleged? Clearly mark unverified Production observations. For a security vulnerability do **not** use this public issue form; follow [SECURITY.md](../../SECURITY.md).
